title: flare/teams-transfer/v1
description: The team after the transfer, with its new owner; your role is now member.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

created.description: When flare created the team, in RFC 3339 UTC; none for a directory team.

managed_by.description: Who keeps the team: `flare`, or `directory` for a team that your organisation's directory keeps and flare cannot change.

members.description: How many members the team has, its owner included.

owner.description: The owner's identifier; none for a team that your organisation's directory keeps.

role.description: What you are to the team: `owner` or `member`.
